title: Deep neural network grades ulcerative colitis endoscopy, validated prospectively
summary: The DNUC network was trained on 40,758 colonoscopy images and 6,885 biopsy results from 2,012 patients at one Japanese centre. In a prospective study of 875 patients it identified endoscopic remission with 90.1% accuracy (kappa 0.798) against endoscopist findings and histologic remission with 92.9% accuracy. The study is single-centre.
ai_technology: Deep neural network (DNUC) for ulcerative colitis endoscopic images

evidence.tested: Accuracy of endoscopic and histologic remission assessment in a prospective study of 875 patients after training on earlier patients.
evidence.unknown: Single-centre Japanese cohort; reference standard is endoscopist-reported findings and biopsy; clinical benefit not shown; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep neural network scoring ulcerative colitis endoscopic images.
